SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — NOT PNW POLICY

Synthetic graduate admission guidance

Published requirements for the 2030-2031 graduate catalog

  1. Review the requirements published for the intended graduate program.
  2. Prepare the materials named by that program before submitting an application.
  3. Submit the fictional graduate application for review by the graduate program.

These steps are general guidance for graduate applicants. They do not decide whether any person is admissible or guarantee an admission decision.
